transforms.name: GrokUpdateNormalizer
transforms.effect: Session log user, thought, message, and turn records become turn, reasoning, and assistant events.

transforms.name: control-session
transforms.effect: The ACP control rail is allowed to contribute permission requests beside the native log.

transforms.name: allowedWithObserver
transforms.effect: Host-side ACP permission requests are forwarded while the session observer is attached.

transforms.name: interactionKind
transforms.effect: pending_interaction plan_approval becomes a choice and any other non-permission kind becomes mixed, both projected as question blockers. The upsert copies no questions array.

transforms.name: pi-or-turn
transforms.effect: turn:completed and turn:failed are produced by the turn normalizer. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: translateAgentEventEnvelope
transforms.effect: Maps the AgentEvent into monitor family updates. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptAgentEvent
transforms.effect: Admits the runtime-plane input. session:exited and process:exited do not clear liveness without host process evidence. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptSemantic
transforms.effect: Parses the adapter batch and stores it on the semantic plane. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: selectClaims
transforms.effect: Keeps one current claim per family key across the runtime and semantic planes. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: projectAgentMonitorState
transforms.effect: Projects AgentMonitorState. Usage cost is folded here, before the backend builds the row. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies the projected runtime state onto the host row, applying host defaults.

transforms.name: projectBlockers
transforms.effect: Pending interactions and active failures become blockers, failure before question before permission. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

applicability.notes: Views listed are confirmed readers in the five shipping monitor views.

verification.notes: Declared status=supported. Root turn activity is captured; structured ACP permissions require the control rail. A subagent child turn (its queue/changed runningPromptId until its turn_completed, forwarded under the child sessionId) is the subagent actor’s activity; other child-session status, such as a child permission request, is not projected. Without a host approval handler the request is left to the native viewer (presentation native-tui). Grok reports no outcome for a viewer answer, so it is settled from the tool call that follows (in_progress/completed allowed; toolNotRun rejected denied, cancelled dismissed) or the turn cancellation; a request no evidence settles ends unknown at turn end, transport close, or disposal. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
